mapper.select: SELECT tbm.fnumber as contract_code, tbc1.FNUMBER as client_code, gac.FNUMBER as account_code,gac.FNAME_L2 as account_name, sum(NULLIF(DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '1', COALESCE(GAV.FLOCALAMOUNT,GE.FLOCALAMOUNT), '0'), 0)) debitAmount, sum(NULLIF(DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '0', COALESCE(GAV.FLOCALAMOUNT,GE.FLOCALAMOUNT), '0'), 0)) creditAmount FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER GV INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID =gv.FCOMPANYID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_PERIOD TBP ON TBP.FID =gv.FPERIODID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERENTRY GE ON GV.FID = GE.FBILLID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON GE.FCURRENCYID =tbc.FID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERASSISTRECORD GAV ON GE.FID =GAV.FENTRYID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSISTANTHG HG ON HG.FID =GAV.FASSGRPID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSTACCOUNT aa ON aa.FID = hg.FASSTACCOUNTID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GAC ON GE.FACCOUNTID =GAC.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL tbm ON HG.FMATERIALID =TBM.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CUSTOMER tbc1 ON HG.FCUSTOMERID =TBC1.FID WHERE tbp.FNUMBER ='201901' AND toc.FNUMBER IN ('01-C0001') AND gv.FBIZSTATUS =5 AND hg.FASSTACCOUNTID= 'rSn5IPwOQtykbfJMfKq2CkZaEPg=' GROUP BY tbm.fnumber, tbc1.FNUMBER, gac.FNUMBER, gac.FNAME_L2

SELECT t.fid AS eas_id, t.FNUMBER AS voucher_code, tbp.FNUMBER AS period_code, tbv.FNUMBER AS voucher_type_code, tbv.FNAME_L2 AS voucher_type_name, t.FBIZDATE AS business_date, t.FBOOKEDDATE AS voucher_date, t.FLOCALDEBITAMOUNT AS base_debit_amount, t.FLOCALCREDITAMOUNT AS base_credit_amount, t.FREPORTINGDEBITAMOUNT AS report_debit_amount, t.FREPORTINGCREDITAMOUNT AS report_credit_amount, t.FBIZSTATUS AS voucher_status, tbc.FISOCODE AS currency_code, toc.FNUMBER AS org_id, toc.FNAME_L2 AS org_name, t.FABSTRACT AS voucher_abstract, t.FDESCRIPTION AS voucher_description FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER t INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID = t.FCOMPANYID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_PERIOD TBP ON TBP.FID =t.FPERIODID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_VOUCHERTYPES tbv ON tbv.FID = t.FVOUCHERTYPEID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON tbc.FID = t.FCURRENCYID WHERE tbp.FNUMBER = #{periodCode} AND t.FBIZSTATUS =5 AND TO_CHAR(t.FBOOKEDDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{voucherDate} AND t.FABSTRACT NOT IN ('结转损益','结转损益-资产减值损失','结转损益6041.03','结转损益6701.04')

SELECT t.fid AS eas_id, t.FNUMBER AS voucher_code, tbp.FNUMBER AS period_code, tbv.FNUMBER AS voucher_type_code, tbv.FNAME_L2 AS voucher_type_name, t.FBIZDATE AS business_date, t.FBOOKEDDATE AS voucher_date, t.FLOCALDEBITAMOUNT AS base_debit_amount, t.FLOCALCREDITAMOUNT AS base_credit_amount, t.FREPORTINGDEBITAMOUNT AS report_debit_amount, t.FREPORTINGCREDITAMOUNT AS report_credit_amount, t.FBIZSTATUS AS voucher_status, tbc.FISOCODE AS currency_code, toc.FNUMBER AS org_id, toc.FNAME_L2 AS org_name, t.FABSTRACT AS voucher_abstract, t.FDESCRIPTION AS voucher_description FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER t INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID = t.FCOMPANYID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_PERIOD TBP ON TBP.FID =t.FPERIODID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_VOUCHERTYPES tbv ON tbv.FID = t.FVOUCHERTYPEID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON tbc.FID = t.FCURRENCYID WHERE t.fid = #{easVoucherId}

SELECT t.fid AS eas_id, t.FNUMBER AS voucher_code, tbp.FNUMBER AS period_code, tbv.FNUMBER AS voucher_type_code, tbv.FNAME_L2 AS voucher_type_name, t.FBIZDATE AS business_date, t.FBOOKEDDATE AS voucher_date, t.FLOCALDEBITAMOUNT AS base_debit_amount, t.FLOCALCREDITAMOUNT AS base_credit_amount, t.FREPORTINGDEBITAMOUNT AS report_debit_amount, t.FREPORTINGCREDITAMOUNT AS report_credit_amount, t.FBIZSTATUS AS voucher_status, tbc.FISOCODE AS currency_code, toc.FNUMBER AS org_id, toc.FNAME_L2 AS org_name, t.FABSTRACT AS voucher_abstract, t.FDESCRIPTION AS voucher_description FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER t INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID = t.FCOMPANYID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_PERIOD TBP ON TBP.FID =t.FPERIODID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_VOUCHERTYPES tbv ON tbv.FID = t.FVOUCHERTYPEID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON tbc.FID = t.FCURRENCYID WHERE tbp.FNUMBER = #{periodCode} AND t.FBIZSTATUS =5 AND t.FABSTRACT NOT IN ('结转损益','结转损益-资产减值损失','结转损益6041.03','结转损益6701.04')

SELECT ge.FID AS eas_id, ge.FBILLID AS voucher_eas_id, ge.FDESCRIPTION AS voucher_summary, tbm.fnumber AS contract_code, tbm.FNAME_L2 AS contract_name, tbc1.FNUMBER AS client_code, tbc1.FNAME_L2 AS client_name, gac.FNUMBER AS account_code, gac.FNAME_L2 AS account_name, toc.FNUMBER AS org_id, tba1.FBANKACCOUNTNUMBER AS bank_number, tbg1.FNUMBER AS bill_contract_code, tbp.FNUMBER AS period_code, DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '1', 'DR', 'CR') AS debit_credit_type, NULLIF(DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '1', COALESCE(GAV.FORIGINALAMOUNT,GE.FORIGINALAMOUNT), '0'), 0) AS debit_amount, NULLIF(DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '0', COALESCE(GAV.FORIGINALAMOUNT,GE.FORIGINALAMOUNT), '0'), 0) AS credit_amount FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER t INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID =t.FCOMPANYID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_PERIOD TBP ON TBP.FID =t.FPERIODID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERENTRY GE ON t.FID = GE.FBILLID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON GE.FCURRENCYID =tbc.FID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERASSISTRECORD GAV ON GE.FID =GAV.FENTRYID LEFT JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSISTANTHG HG ON HG.FID =GAV.FASSGRPID INNER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GAC ON GE.FACCOUNTID =GAC.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL tbm ON HG.FMATERIALID =TBM.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CUSTOMER tbc1 ON HG.FCUSTOMERID =TBC1.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTBANKS TBA1 ON TBA1.FID =HG.FBANKACCOUNTID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_GENERALASSTACTTYPE tbg1 ON tbg1.FID =HG.FGENERALASSACTTYPE3ID WHERE ge.FBILLID = #{voucherId}

SELECT tbm.fnumber AS contract_code,tbc1.FNUMBER AS client_code ,ga.FNUMBER AS account_code, gba.FENDBALANCEFOR AS account_balance FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_AssistBalance_5F GBA LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID =gba.FORGUNITID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GA ON GBA.FACCOUNTID = GA.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON gba.FCURRENCYID =tbc.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSISTANTHG GS ON GBA.FASSISTGRPID =GS.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL tbm ON GS.FMATERIALID =TBM.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CUSTOMER tbc1 ON GS.FCUSTOMERID =TBC1.FID WHERE GBA.FPERIOD = 201812 AND tbc1.FNUMBER = #{clientCode} AND tbm.fnumber = #{contractCode}

SELECT toc.FNUMBER AS org_id, tbm.fnumber AS contract_code, tbc1.FNUMBER AS client_code, tbg1.FNUMBER AS bill_contract_code, ga.FNUMBER AS account_code, SUM(gba.FBEGINBALANCEFOR) AS account_balance FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_AssistBalance_5F GBA LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID = gba.FORGUNITID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GA ON GBA.FACCOUNTID = GA.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON gba.FCURRENCYID = tbc.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSISTANTHG GS ON GBA.FASSISTGRPID = GS.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL tbm ON GS.FMATERIALID = TBM.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CUSTOMER tbc1 ON GS.FCUSTOMERID = TBC1.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN T_BD_GENERALASSTACTTYPE tbg1 ON tbg1.FID =GS.FGENERALASSACTTYPE3ID WHERE GBA.FPERIOD = #{periodCode} and toc.FNUMBER = '80001'
and tbm.fnumber in
